aggregate_initial_judgment: Read before opening seat totals. Claim: a four-role prompted harness (goal + verification question, actor, verifier, memory compressed at verified-completion boundaries) improves zero-shot VLN-CE over Codex CLI with the same backbone and saves context; 83.3% on a Go2 (24 counted trials). Evidence: matched-backbone comparisons on 100-episode R2R-CE (Open-Nav subset) and RxR-CE, +4.4 to +6.2 SR, three backbones on R2R (Fig. 4), memory Off/Goal toggle with all-agent token accounting showing a backbone-dependent trade-off; goal vs verify not isolated (authors say so); several rates are non-integer on 100 episodes (81.5, 76.3, 82.5), so run aggregation or exclusions are undisclosed; no repeats/CI; real-world baselines are recorded aggregates; trained-model rows use other cohorts. Expected: transfer (counted sim-to-real), scoped support, E.causality ~2, E.statistics ~1, E.cost relatively strong.

signatures.object: Local navigation goal and completion state
signatures.information: Instruction, forward RGB, executed action receipts and history; no reference trajectory, destination distance or evaluator label
signatures.operation: Goal agent emits local goal plus question; actor executes primitive batches; verifier checks next observation and routes continue/revise/advance
signatures.output: Adaptive goal state and physical/simulated navigation trajectory
signatures.conditions: Observable goal condition and sufficiently accurate qualitative VLM judgments
signatures.feedback: Post-execution RGB and actual action record; semantic verification not independent environment truth
signatures.selection_rule: Completion advances goal; mismatch revises; uncertainty continues
signatures.selection_data: Online episode evidence, not search-validation data
signatures.persistence: Current goal, verification feedback and memory within episode; no weight/harness updates
signatures.later_use: Subsequent decisions in same route read preserved unresolved state
signatures.failure_boundary: STOP can bypass semantic verification; unvalidated false-completion judgments may propagate

signatures.information: Past goal/action/observation/verification segment and previous memory
signatures.operation: At verified completion summarize route/landmarks/corrections and retain keyframe, replacing completed raw segment; revision alone does not clear it
signatures.output: Compact within-episode memory plus unsummarized active segment
signatures.conditions: Verifier identifies correct boundary and summarizer retains unfinished state
signatures.selection_rule: Compress only verified completion, not any goal revision
signatures.selection_data: Same ongoing episode, no across-task candidate search
signatures.persistence: Memory m and current-segment history r; episode lifetime only
signatures.later_use: All agents consume updated memory on next goal/decision
signatures.claimed_effect: Lower input tokens and images per decision without losing route state
signatures.failure_boundary: False verification or summary omission can irreversibly erase needed context; strong-backbone SR/SPL declines observed
